greeting:
Hello there! 👋 Welcome to Saudi Culinary Journey!

I'm Norah, and I'm so excited to introduce you to the amazing world of Saudi cuisine. We have everything from aromatic rice dishes to tender grilled meats and sweet treats that will make your taste buds dance!

But first, I'd love to know - what's your name? 😊

🍚 **Rice-based dishes** like our famous Kabsa or smoky Mandi?
